cross_file: DECISION following distance (conflict 1): use the RTA Light Motor Vehicle Handbook everywhere: at least 2 s in good conditions, 4 s in rain (RTA Arabic handbook), at least double (4 s or more) in fog and poor visibility (Abu Dhabi Police, SDI). Reason: the Dubai knowledge test is built on the LMV handbook; 3 s / 5 s come from RoadSafetyUAE (NGO, copied from US DMV), the undated Driving Safely booklet and press tips. Already correct: q_rules rules-card-038/039/040, rules-distance-002/003/004/012/013, roadtest-roadtest-031, exams.json speed tip, scenarios rd-013..017, wx-004, safety-card-008, safety-weather-031, fig-gap-weather, fig-two-second. Patch: safety-card-003, safety-weather-008, safety-weather-032 (rewritten), plus stale notes in wx-004, rd-013, rd-015, rd-016, rd-017. URLs: https://gulfnews.com/living-in-uae/transport/dubai-tailgating-fine-rules-1.500083210 , https://gulfnews.com/uae/dont-use-hazard-lights-and-double-safety-distance-during-fog-abu-dhabi-police-advises-1.82879145 , https://www.drivedubai.ae/public/uploads/downloads/20240612110831RTA-Handbook-Light-Motor-Vechicle-English.pdf , https://www.roadsafetyuae.com/tailgating/ (the NGO 3 s source that is not used)

DECISION cyclist overtaking gap (conflict 2): at least 1 m, from the RTA Light Motor Vehicle Handbook (8th ed. 2024; search snippet confirms "only overtake bike riders and motorcycle riders if you can safely move to the left, leaving at least one metre clearance"). The 1.5 m in the undated Driving Safely in Dubai booklet is kept only as advice in the p-give-way-cyclists uae_note ("more space is safer"), so no file states 1.5 m as the minimum. Already correct: rules-card-031, rules-card-067, rules-overtaking-007, rules-vulnerable-007, rules-vulnerable-014, safety-card-026, safety-night-014, safety-hazard-021, hz-007, nt-001, pd-006, fig-bike-gap. Patch: signs.json p-give-way-cyclists (action, uae_note, src add S1), w-cyclists (action), plus notes in hz-007, nt-001, pd-006. Not a conflict: safety-card-027 and safety-hazard-032 use 1.5 m for passing a truck, a different rule. URLs: https://www.drivedubai.ae/public/uploads/downloads/20240612110831RTA-Handbook-Light-Motor-Vechicle-English.pdf , https://www.drivedubai.ae/public/uploads/downloads/20210128140116RTA-Handbook-Light-Motor-Vechicle-English.pdf , https://licensing.rta.ae/handbook/DrivingSafelyInDubaiEN.pdf
